production.note: US model years. First: Porsche's US release of 18 July 2024 ("The 2025 Porsche Panamera Turbo S E-Hybrid and Panamera GTS") says both "are now available to order and are expected to reach U.S. Porsche Centers in late Q1 2025." Still on sale: porsche.com/usa lists the 2027 Panamera Turbo S E-Hybrid (listed on the same page with "Max. power combined 771 hp") (porsche-usa-panamera-gts-2027). The 971 Panamera models are separate records.

body.note: Porsche calls the Panamera a "four-door sports car"; a four-door liftback (C/D panel: "4-passenger, 4-door hatchback"), recorded as Sedan as in the 971 Panamera record. No Sport Turismo is sold on the 976.

configuration.note: Panel: "twin-turbocharged and intercooled DOHC 32-valve 4.0-liter V-8, 591 hp, 590 lb-ft + AC motor, 187 hp, 331 lb-ft".

displacementL.note: "Both models are powered by the further developed 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8 engine"; the GTS panel gives this engine as "3996 cm3" (cd-panamera-gts-2025), i.e. 3,996 cc.

fuel.note: Panel: "22-kWh lithium-ion battery pack; peak charge rate, AC 11.0 kW" (chargeable from the grid); porsche.com/usa lists it as "Hybrid" (porsche-usa-panamera-gts-2027).

drivetrain.note: Panel: "front-engine, front-motor, all-wheel-drive"; Motor Authority: "Drive is to all four wheels" (motorauthority-panamera-gts-tseh-2024).

transmission.note: "The 8-speed Porsche dual clutch transmission (PDK) has been significantly improved." Panel: "Transmission: 8-speed dual-clutch automatic". DCT is Porsche PDK, with the electric motor integrated in it.

powerHp.note: Combined system output. Panel quote: "(combined output: 771 hp, 737 lb-ft; 22-kWh lithium-ion battery pack; peak charge rate, AC 11.0 kW)". Manufacturer: "its system output has been increased by 81 hp to 575 kW (771 hp)"; the V8 alone "develops an output of 441 kW (591 hp)" (porsche-us-panamera-gts-tseh-2024). porsche.com/usa, 2027: "Max. power combined 771 hp".

weightLb.note: Car and Driver road-test curb weight (weight-order step 2), 2025 model, 8-speed PDK (the only transmission). Panel quote: "Curb Weight: 5350 lb". The test car carried options (panel lists the Premium package, rear comfort seats and others), so a standard car may be slightly lighter. No Porsche Cars North America curb weight was found (none in the release; the porsche.com/usa technical-data section did not render).
